text.en: Believing Raman scattering and fluorescence are the same process under different names, rather than Raman scattering being a fast, near-instantaneous inelastic scattering event and fluorescence being a full absorption followed by a much slower re-emission after the electron partially relaxes.
text.et: Uskumine, et Raman-hajumine ja fluorestsents on sama protsess erineva nimetuse all, mitte see, et Raman-hajumine on kiire, peaaegu hetkeline mitteelastne hajumissündmus, ja fluorestsents on täielik neeldumine, millele järgneb palju aeglasem taaskiirgumine pärast elektroni osalist lõõgastumist.
